system.description:
• Founded by Kiyo, whose hidden monastery in Tenor trains those seeking to avenge their master's death at the hands of The Omniscience.
  • The order has strong ties to the Keepers of Tariel.
  • Kiyo's teachings centre on freedom and the absence of the ego — students are encouraged to become adventurers, to protect the weak, and to follow their own moral compass above any law.
  • Many Disciples travel alongside the Keepers while striving to embody Kiyo's example.
  • Dragon's Reflex: A natural 15 or higher on your Deflect Blow check succeeds whatever the attack roll was.
  • Kiyo's Legacy: Advantage on checks to identify or gather information about The Omniscience or their agents, and recognised as an ally on sight by the Keepers of Tariel.
